result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now exists as a second name for `updateLandscape`. It compiles (`mvn -o -pl cli compile`), but I didn't run any tests or run either command, so the dispatch and `-help` output are untested.

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is now listed in the no-argument usage overview, using the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names go to the same `updateLandscape` method, so the options and the `config.json` and `index.html` output are shared. The method now takes the command name and description, so `-help` prints usage for whichever name was typed. `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and notes that `updateLandscape` is the same command, kept for existing scripts.
